title: LandslideFM: A Foundation Model Towards Unified Landslide Perception and Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.12936v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Intelligent landslide detection is essential for disaster prevention. However, existing models primarily focus on isolated visual tasks, require extensive labeled data, and lack deep analytical and scene-understanding capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose LandslideFM, the first unified foundation model that connects visual perception tasks with contextual interpretation of landslides. Specifically, LandslideFM adapts to multiple visual tasks via a Source-Agreement Graduated Trust semi-supervised learning framework that leverages limited labeled data alongside abundant unlabeled data. Furthermore, predicted landslide regions provide explicit spatial guidance to a Vision-Language Model adapted through parameter-efficient fine-tuning, enabling comprehensive landslide reasoning. translated_title: LandslideFM：面向滑坡统一感知与理解的基础模型
translated_abstract: 智能滑坡检测对灾害防治至关重要。然而，现有模型主要聚焦于孤立的视觉任务，需要大量标注数据，且缺乏深层分析与场景理解能力。为解决这些局限，我们提出了LandslideFM，这是首个将视觉感知任务与滑坡情境解读相连接的统一基础模型。具体而言，LandslideFM通过一个“源一致性渐进信任”半监督学习框架适应多种视觉任务，该框架能够利用有限的标注数据与大量无标注数据。此外，预测出的滑坡区域为通过参数高效微调适配的视觉-语言模型提供显式空间引导，从而实现全面的滑坡推理能力。为支持该领域的训练与评估，我们还提出了LandslideVL，这是首个智能滑坡分析基准数据集，结合了视觉（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了首个统一的滑坡基础模型LandslideFM，通过半监督学习框架利用有限标注数据完成多种视觉感知任务，并结合参数高效微调的视觉-语言模型实现滑坡的情境理解与推理，同时发布了首个智能滑坡分析基准数据集LandslideVL。
en_tdlr: LandslideFM is the first unified foundation model that bridges landslide visual perception and contextual understanding, leveraging a semi-supervised learning framework for multiple vision tasks and a parameter-efficiently fine-tuned vision-language model for landslide reasoning, accompanied by the first benchmark LandslideVL.
